Name: Staircase Placement Fix
Author: Becks723
Description:
[size=5][b]中文：[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
修复矿洞部分地皮无法放置楼梯的问题。

[size=5][b]下载&安装[/b][/size]
[size=3][list=1]
[*]下载并安装[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]。
[*]下载此模组，解压并放入[i]Mods[/i]文件夹。
[i](Android)[/i]开头的文件为安卓版本。
[*]完成！
[/list][/size]


[size=5][b]效果展示[/b][/size]

[size=4]之前[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DwqKkZCm/bug.gif[/img]
[size=2][i]（某些矿洞地皮放不了楼梯，甚至一下给你鬼畜掉好几个楼梯，造成财产损失。[size=1]这好吗？这不好[/size]）[/i][/size]

[size=4]之后[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fTV80rmN/image.gif[/img]

[/spoiler]

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[size=3][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]。
[*]Download this mod. Unzip and put into [i]Mods[/i] folder.
Files starts with [i](Android)[/i] are for Android.
[*]Done!
[/list][/size]


[size=5][b]Use[/b][/size]

[size=3]Before[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/DwqKkZCm/bug.gif[/img]
[size=2][i](For some special mine tiles, placing stairs can cause misalignment and even waste several of your stairs.)[/i][/size]

[size=3]After[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/fTV80rmN/image.gif[/img]
[size=2][i](Fixed!)[/i][/size]
